fields.Name: T184 - Chapter Officers Drilldown
fields.Description: Verifies a Chapter's full record form exposes a related Chapter Officers (or Chapter Memberships) section that renders related rows or a valid empty-state.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Chapters' entity via the left sidebar 'Search entities...' box: click the search box, type 'Chapters', then click the exact 'Chapters' node in the results (do NOT expand the entity group/chevron). Open a chapter record's full form (click a row, then click 'Open Full Record'). Scroll down to the form's related-records sections and open the 'Chapter Officers' (or 'Chapter Memberships') related section. Verify it shows related rows OR a valid empty-state (the related section being present and rendering is success). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait patiently, do not navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A Chapter full record form is open showing chapter detail fields
A related 'Chapter Officers' or 'Chapter Memberships' section is present and rendering - showing related rows OR a valid empty-state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
